testcase.name: DELETE api-keys should return 400 when already revoked()

POST api-keys should return 400 when name is blank()

POST api-keys should return 403 without apikey manage permission()
DELETE api-keys should return 200 when revoked()
POST api-keys should return 400 with invalid permissions()
